name: Customer 4
definition: Information related to a consumer or a company.

ReferenceNumber.name: Reference Number
ReferenceNumber.definition: Reference number provided by a cardholder or customer to card acceptor to facilitate communication and record keeping.  The value may be a reference number, code, or generic number.

TaxRegistrationIdentification.name: Tax Registration Identification
TaxRegistrationIdentification.definition: Identification of the customer recognized by the taxation authority.

AuthorisedContactName.name: Authorised Contact Name
AuthorisedContactName.definition: Corporate individual or company (cardholder or their company) to be contacted for authorised purchases.

AuthorisedContactPhoneNumber.name: Authorised Contact Phone Number
AuthorisedContactPhoneNumber.definition: Phone number of an individual or|company contacted for company authorised purchases.
